_doc: Frontline prop/static -> MOHAA swaps, used only where the replacement is clearly better and fits (same object type, period, scale, footprint). Everything referenced comes from the player's own MOHAA install or the mod's paks; nothing from Frontline is shipped. 'reskin' = render-only facade swap of a Frontline texture's vertical faces (collision untouched). 'props' = MOHAA models placed at Frontline placement classes. Each entry carries its reason.

16c480.reason: Frontline's hedges are opaque boxes (422 vertical faces, no tops; the user called them solid-looking). MOHAA has no usable hedge MODEL (the mod's models/hedgerow.tik is a broken Call of Duty port: missing .skc); MOHAA's own Normandy bocage is brush cards with textures/misc_outside/hedgerow.tga (HD in zzzzz_hd_foliage), so the same art is used the same way: facade-mapped on the box sides, crown raised 25% so the leafy alpha top replaces the flat edge. Render only - the hedge collision brushes are Frontline's, unchanged.

BreakingWoodBoxSwap.reason: Frontline's 20 breakable wooden boxes are separate Frontline models (not converted), so the map had none. MOHAA's own wooden crate (indycrate, stock) is the same object and period; breakable like our barrels (on damage: stock crate debris, removed). The mod's models/custom/wood_crate.tik was the first choice but is broken in the installed paks (missing .skc).

no_swap.JeepTire_1_1: MOHAA has no tire/wheel model; left out (Frontline's own model is not converted).
no_swap.DoorSwingCW: MOHAA's only door model is a frame (static/door_frame); Frontline's door stays as its level geometry.
no_swap.MountedMachineGun: Already MOHAA MG42 nests (statweapons) placed by the map script inside Frontline's baked sandbag rings.

M1_1_ResistanceDrop.reason: Frontline's resistance supply drop (objective 1) is a parachute supply crate; MOHAA's stock supplydropcrate is exactly that object (crate with its chute), so the drop is visible where the use-objective is. Kept as a position (objective 1 reads level.fl_pos); only the marker model changes (was the stand-in exp_crate1a).
